environment.scenario: streamed resume of an approved function tool followed by an output guardrail tripwire

conclusion: In 0.18.3 the approved tool side effect occurred, but the streamed resume session persisted only the tool call after the output guardrail aborted the run. In 0.19.3 the session persisted the complete tool call/output pair before guardrail evaluation, and the pair was available on the next turn. Business idempotency is still required because the SDK fix does not provide exactly-once side effects.
